`github checkout-prs` now switches HEAD only when exactly one PR is checked out. If it checks out several PRs, it puts you back on the branch you started from. I haven't run it or the test suite, and I didn't add regression tests. You asked for them, but your instructions said not to touch tests.

- **Cause:** creating each local branch (`create_branch` in `git_machete/git_operations.py`) runs `git checkout -b`. Each PR's branch therefore moved HEAD along the way.
- **Fix:** `git_machete/client.py` now records the current branch before the loop. If the final single-PR condition isn't met, it checks that branch out again. If you started on a detached HEAD, there is no branch to return to, so HEAD stays wherever the last checkout left it.
- **Docs:** I changed "If only one PR is given" to "If only one PR has been checked out" in `git_machete/docs.py` and `docs/source/cli_help/github.rst`.

For your example (starting on `develop`, three PRs by `amalota`), you should end up back on `develop`.
